The author's motive to explore the lessons of history and the interplay between past, present, and future is structurally realized through a narrative centered on archaeology. By having characters uncover ancient remains, the text physically manifests the theme of continuity, allowing the abstract concept of time to drive the plot and character development. This structural choice ensures that the thematic exploration of how history shapes the present is not just stated but enacted through the discovery process.

The country famous for the Great Barrier Reef is Australia.
